steps.en: Start the terminal UI with a working folder and chosen provider
steps.zh: 指定工作目录与模型，启动终端界面

steps.en: Describe the local document or browser task
steps.zh: 描述本地文档或浏览器任务

steps.en: Choose tools and request approval for gated actions
steps.zh: 选择工具，并为受控操作请求审批

steps.en: Execute tools and return an answer with local session state
steps.zh: 执行工具，交回回答并在本地保存会话

value.en: One local operator carries the task across tools and turns
value.zh: 由同一本地操作助手衔接工具与多轮任务
